about.title: Electrical Panel Designer
about.subtitle: A browser-based tool for designing DIN rail electrical distribution boards

features.title: Features
items: Visual DIN rail panel layout editor
Drag-and-drop element placement from a component palette
MCBs, RCDs, RCBOs, isolators, surge protection, and more
Multi-rail panels with configurable slot counts
Design validation with error and warning reporting
Electrical calculators (cable sizing, voltage drop, fault current)
All data stored locally — no account required

standards.title: Standards
standards.description: Designed for use with BS 7671 (IET Wiring Regulations) and IEC 60364. Slot widths follow the 18mm DIN rail module convention.

technology.title: Technology
technology.description: Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Canvas rendering uses the HTML5 Canvas API. State persisted via localStorage.
